name: zinc finger MYM-type containing 3

function.text: ZMYM3 encodes zinc finger MYM-type protein 3. Annotated molecular activities include zinc ion binding.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Prostate Adenocarcinoma; Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma; Invasive Breast Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
